cause: Native options fadeOut retains pointer-events:auto at z-index29999 until jQuery fade completes; history shadow at4100 and popup at2066 are already visible during that interval. All settled samples hit select_chat_cross.
testTiming: The failing reachable() checks elementFromPoint immediately after visibility and viewport assertions; it does not await options jQuery fade or shadow CSS transition. Existing settle() is scoped to workspace-view for this flow and would also miss these body-level overlays without a relevant root.

observed.scope: Actual pointer close/reopen of actions while original local history response held; no generation or provider calls.

separateLifetimeFinding.classification: Confirmed old awaited history action hides a newer reopened Actions menu when its search completes. Source hideMenu runs unconditionally after await displayPastChats. No implementation changes in this probe.

limits: Six local headless Chromium repeats at844x390 with actual pointer native menu/history/Close and selected white background. No claim for all browsers or physical devices.
Immediate center-hit failures are transient in this probe; a raw pointer click during the fade was not used to claim successful Close. Actual Close was clicked after animations settled.
Async newer-menu dismissal is a separate behavior defect, not evidence of a persistent Close obstruction.
